title: YourBench: Easy Custom Evaluation Sets for Everyone

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating both (A, B) and (B, A) pairings of model responses in a pairwise comparative assessment using LLM judges, and computing a bias-corrected score to counteract the judge's tendency to prefer an answer based on its presentation order.
Employing an ensemble of multiple diverse judge LLMs in the pairwise evaluation strategy to mitigate the tendency of a single LLM to inherently prefer its own generated text.
